mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, which typically signals robust economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is above its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) and low employment growth (PAYEMS < 135000 thousand persons) indicates a weak labor market, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, characterized by rising federal funds rates, the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which often leads to aggressive monetary policy responses and reduced equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods (UNRATE < 5.0), or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) and housing starts (HOUST < 800) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During an early-cycle recovery phase, characterized by rising industrial production, the S&P 500 typically experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth gains momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods classified as early-cycle recovery, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
